author: Xy_Lose
description:
This layout is mainly concise and practical, with some learning curve; some controls can trigger different functions with different methods, * is long-press, + is double-tap. 
This layout is a derivative work based on HMCL-PE Default; I think HMCL-PE's style is clean and beautiful, the full keys are comfortable and easy to use, it is overall simple but lacks functional keys, so I recreated it on that basis.
 You are free to modify and redistribute it with the original author's name retained. Note: only major changes can be released in FCL's built-in "Download Layout"; minor fixes and suggestions can be filed as issues at https://github.com/ysesiq/FCL-Controllers/tree/main or sent as a private message to https://space.bilibili.com/558094130; you may not profit from this layout (and no one should do that?).
